title: Chapter 430 Encountering A Profligate Merchant
content:
Chapter 430 Encountering A Profligate Merchant

After thinking it through, Bai Xu quickly got up, sorted out his wrinkled clothes, and left here.

I don't see it and I'm not upset.

There are so many opportunities in the deserted city, why hang yourself on a tree?

What's more, this is still a dead tree that does not bloom.

"Senior, don't worry, the deserted city is so big, I will definitely be able to find a treasure that will restore your strength."

Bai Xu left Huangcheng Square, clenched his fists and said firmly.

At the wrist, the bracelet lights up slightly, "I hope there will be."

Just as Bai Xu left the Huangcheng Square, the list of geniuses, which had not been moving for a long time, suddenly emitted a faint breath. At first, no one noticed this slight aura.

But as the breath becomes stronger.

Buzz —

A light sound aroused the hearts of all the geniuses present, which had long been unable to control themselves.

Fanatical shouts sounded from the Huangcheng Square, as if they were about to lift the entire sky.

"The list of geniuses is about to be opened!"

At this time, Bai Xu, who had already walked away, was carefully looking at a small street stall on the street. The dazzling array of small items made Bai Xu narrow his eyes.

With his eyesight, he naturally can't understand anything, but he has Senior Hao.

Just when he wanted Senior Hao to help him identify if there were any treasures here and whether he could pick up a vacancy, a cry suddenly came to his ears.

Bai Xu stood there in a daze, and the bronze fragments in his hand fell to the ground.

jingle!

A crisp sound rang out, Bai Xu opened his mouth wide and shouted: "What! The list of geniuses is on!!!"

"Boy, what's the point? If you smash something, you will have to pay for it!"

The stall owner carefully picked up the bronze fragments on the ground and looked at Bai Xu with some anger.

But at this time, Bai Xu was not in a mood to care about this, and he was about to sprint towards the square.

However, he had just started, and a breath directly suppressed him.

Bai Xu was stunned and turned his head stiffly to look at the stall owner.

At this moment, the stall owner gently wiped the bronze fragments in his hand and looked at Bai Xu with a smile on his face, "Boy, for the sake of you being a foreigner, I will smash my things to you. No investigation will be made, but you must buy it, otherwise you will not be able to get out of this street."

Feeling the strong sense of threat, Bai Xu swallowed his saliva and said in a trembling voice: "How much is it?"

The stall owner smiled and stretched out three fingers.

Bai Xu did not dare to neglect and quickly took out thirty Chaos Crystals.

This is the currency circulating in the entire Chaos Realm. The chaotic aura stored in it can greatly increase the benefits of cultivation. Bai Xu was able to take out thirty Chaos Crystals, which can be said to be a little rich man.

The imagined stall owner smiled but did not appear. The stall owner placed the bronze fragments in front of Bai Xu and said expressionlessly: "This thing is part of the Human Emperor Cauldron. Later, the Human Emperor disappeared, this person The imperial tripod was divided into several copies and distributed to all parts of the world."

"As long as you find one of them, you can find the remaining fragments through induction, collect all the Human Emperor Cauldrons, and be invincible in the world."

"So, this fragment is worth 30,000 Chaos Crystals."

"What!?"

Bai Xu jumped up directly when he heard this amazing number. He looked at the unpretentious stall owner in front of him, and was extremely shocked.

Unexpectedly, this would be a heinous businessman.

How long has he been in the industry? Even though he has encountered several very good inheritances, he does not have ten thousand Chaos crystals on his body. No, he doesn’t even have three thousand.

"Are you not afraid of retribution when you sell things like this?"

Bai Xu still didn't want to make things worse, and he tried his best tone to be calm.

He still wants to go to the Tianjiao List now.

"You can't control why I sell things. Stop talking nonsense, get the money quickly. This is a fragment of the Human Emperor Cauldron."

The stall owner continued to be aggressive.

Bai Xu's face looked ugly. What kind of Human Emperor Cauldron can you believe it?

But he had no choice, and he would definitely not be able to leave without paying for it.

At this time, Senior Hao was already evaporated as if he had evaporated in the world. He didn't dare to let go of a single fart. Bai Xu did not ask Senior Hao for help. After all, he is short of money now, and Senior Hao's pocket is cleaner than his face.

"Senior, I, I don't have that much money."

Bai Xu stuttered.

"No money?"

The stall owner looked at Bai Xu, pointed to the bracelet on Bai Xu's wrist and said, "Let's do this, you look very pitiful. I'll suffer a little, just exchange this for me."

"Ah? Senior, this is not OK. This is my ancestor."

Bai Xu was startled and quickly put his hand behind him.

"Then there is nothing else, give it money. Anyway, if you don't have money, you can't leave."

The stall owner sat on the ground, without any master's demeanor.

At this time, several people from the deserted city not far away could not stand it.

"Wenbazi, don't go too far, just catch honest bullying."

"That's, eating something inside and out."

Everyone did not hide their contempt for Bai Xu's stall owner in front of him, but the stall owner named Wen Bazi shouted, "What's wrong, turn your arm outwards and look at outsiders, right?"

This sentence immediately choked back the people around him who wanted to help Bai Xu.

"Boy, no one will help you, pay the money quickly."

Wenbazi continued to look at Bai Xu with an arrogant expression.

"How to sell this?"

And at this moment, a figure seemed to appear out of thin air, and suddenly stood in front of Wen Bazi's stall, picked up a stick and asked.

Wen Bazi was slightly stunned and said, "Ten thousand chaos,,,"

Bang!

Before Wen Bazi could finish his words, the person in front of him poked Wen Bazi away with a stick.

"Why don't the fuck you don't go to grab it?!"

It seemed that he was still unhappy, and the person who took action picked up the stick and headed towards Wen Bazi angrily.

"You, who are you? I am from Huangcheng!"

"I'm still a fucking inner city!"

Seeing Wen Bazi being beaten unilaterally, Bai Xu's nose was slightly sore, and he was very moved.

"Boy, do you still remember me?"

Behind Bai Xu, a voice suddenly sounded.

Bai Xu's body trembled slightly and he turned around suddenly.

I saw an old man wearing a cloth robes and a broken sword on his waist looking at him with a smile.

"Senior Broken Sword!"

The person who came was the old man Broken Sword.

Shi Tianzhi was there next to the old man Broken Sword. He looked at Bai Xu and nodded slightly, "Young man, you often meet noble people."

Bai Xu didn't understand the meaning of this sentence, and at this time, the old man who beat Wen Bazi slowly walked from a distance and cursed: "This little thing is really a shameless person. ah."

At this time, Wen Bazi was already lying on the ground like a dead dog, without any complaints.

Because he knew that the other party was from the inner city.

The gap between status and status made him afraid to feel dissatisfied.

It is no exaggeration to say that if the inner city people want to deal with him, they don’t even need to speak in person. As long as a trace of intention is exposed, countless people will take action instead.
